title: Dispatch FLE 4: Two Expedition Logs Describe the Same Return
summary: One path led home; the other led to a family in Kingsfen.
topic: A Funeral for a Living Eidetician
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: The Institute compared the competing logs. At a fork in the Stratum, Dr. Voss marked two routes that appeared equally passable. Her present account follows the left path. The report held by the mourners follows the right and ends eight years later.

Dr. Saye believes both accounts may have reached Alderwick, though not through the same years. The woman buried under Dr. Voss’s name may have lived the other life. Her daughter has asked the living explorer to stop calling that life a mistake. The right-hand route appears to have contained eight years while only weeks passed here.
